notes.title: [Playtest 0.0.4] Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]V0.0.4[/h1]
[h2]MANAGEMENT:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a display bug in Tournament page.
[*]Fixed a display bug where players were decapitated on mouse-over.
[*]Fixed a bug where a player input freeze the conversation.
[*]Fixed a bug where leaving the match page breaks Picks & Bans.
[/list]
[h2]SIMULATION:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Defusers are no longer lost at the end of the round.
[*]Fixed a bug where bullets disappeared in walls.
[*]Fixed a display bug in player UI
[/list]
